note: Exchange book check (FLAG ONLY) for sharp-monitor phone alerts with 2h+ lead. latest/first = Novig (public order books, no key); prophetx_latest/prophetx_first = ProphetX (read-only key; prices are AFTER its 2%% fee on winnings, displayed price kept as best_price_american_displayed): best_price_american, dollars_at_best and dollars_at_alert_price_or_better = amount you could bet at the alert price or better, buy_levels = the ladder. kalshi_latest/_first and polymarket_latest/_first: same fields (public books, no key), prices AFTER taker fees (Kalshi 0.07, Polymarket global 0.03 x P x (1-P) per contract unless gamma marks the market zero-fee; displayed price kept as best_price_american_displayed). Novig pregame: no fee. hardrock_latest/_first: Hard Rock sportsbook price and line via The Odds API (no order book; refreshed every 30 min). best_now = best gettable price across the books, plus total dollars at the alert price or better on books with the exact line. Novig fields: best_price = cheapest cost to BUY the alert side now (0-1, with American); dollars_at_alert_price_or_better = dollars you could buy at the alert's price or better on the same line; exact_line=false means Novig had no market at the alert's line and the nearest line is shown. resting_bids_on_this_side_dollars = others bidding the same side. 'first' = first check after the alert, 'latest' = this run. Novig orders are bids (verified Oct 21).
